cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Ready on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest, hopeful, or vulnerable only in forms that preserve your emotional safety.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll sit by the door. You can have the chair where I used to coach you through your speeches. Tonight let me find the words.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Knowing I can leave helps me stay. Don't jump to the ending; you used to lose half your speech that way.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can stop when you need to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Then I want to come home. Don't hand me a key yet. You remember how we practised one sentence at a time? Let that be mine tonight.

reason: Give familiar coaching habits a concrete function in A pursuit. Preserve legible stakes and partner contributions; where source interaction is unspecified, establish a specific topic rather than rely on charitable backstory.
